To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

there are several challenges in the implementation of eLearning in Kenyan public university and these include lack of adequate funding, lack of adequate infrastructure, lack of qualified staff to manage and maintain eLearning, and lack of awareness of e-learning among students.
e-learning implementation in Kenyan universities faces challenges of inadequate infrastructure, inadequate training and support, lack of e-learning policy and inadequate funding.

e-learning is an important tool for teaching and learning in Kenyan public Universities but its effective implementation is hindered by a number of challenges that include inadequate infrastructure, limited ICT skills among staff, lack of adequate funds and lack of a comprehensive policy on e-learning.
